name.value: Axis Max Life Smart Ultra Protect Rider
name.quote: Axis Max Life Smart Ultra Protect Rider

linked_or_non_linked.value: unit-linked base, individual health insurance rider; level rider premium, not a charge from the fund

attached_to_ulips.note: Named by all 9 Axis Max ULIPs.

waiver_of_premium.value: Payor Benefit (variant 4): on the death or terminal illness of the policyholder, the company funds all future premiums under the base policy and waives all future premiums under attached riders. Applies only when the policyholder and the life insured are different people. Not triggered by disability or critical illness.
waiver_of_premium.quote: Fund all future outstanding premiums, as and when due, under the base policy and
waiver_of_premium.note: Unambiguous: "under the base policy". Once accepted, the present value of future premiums (at 5.50% a year) is paid on termination of the base policy.

waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.value: not covered. Death of the life insured is covered by the term booster option.

accidental_death.value: Accidental Death Benefit: rider sum assured on death by accident of the life insured, up to 75 years maturity age. Return of premium option available.
